markdownRemark.html:
谈坛的 Android 正文翻译由 Google 翻译提供，使用 Google ML Kit 的设备端语言识别和翻译模型。翻译独立于「智能化」设置，关闭 AI 或设备不支持 Gemini Nano 时，仍可使用正文翻译。

如何翻译帖子

  • 点按帖子工具栏的翻译图标，默认翻译为设备语言。再次点按即可切回原文。
  • 长按翻译图标可以选择目标语言。「设置」的常规分组中可关闭自动翻译。
  • 首次翻译某些语言时，谈坛会通过 Wi‑Fi 按需下载语言包。下载完成后，已经加载的正文可以离线翻译。

数据如何处理

待翻译的正文文字在设备上处理。谈坛不会为了此功能把正文发送给云端翻译服务。翻译保留图片和链接地址；如果语言包未能下载或翻译失败，仍可阅读原文，应用不会自动改用生成式 AI 翻译。

翻译归属与准确性

Android 译文由 Google 翻译自动生成，译文旁会显示 Google 翻译标识。机器翻译可能出现错误，尤其是专有名词、论坛用语和需要结合上下文理解的段落。涉及重要信息时，请对照原文。

Google 不对译文作出任何明示或默示保证，包括准确性、可靠性、适销性、特定用途适用性或不侵权。完整声明请见 Google 翻译归属与免责声明。

At the same time, we have no tolerance for abuse. We also strongly oppose the use of our services to make any political remarks and to act accordingly.

Open source software is important to us. Some software used in our Services may be offered under an open source license that we will make available to you. There may be provisions in the open source license that expressly override some of these terms.

Modifying and Terminating our Services

We are constantly changing and improving our Services. We may add or remove functionalities or features, and we may suspend or stop a Service altogether.

You can stop using our Services at any time, although we’ll be sorry to see you go. Discuzhub may also stop providing Services to you, or add or create new limits to our Services at any time.

We provide the Services “as is”.

Some jurisdictions provide for certain warranties, like the implied warranty of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. To the extent permitted by law, we exclude all warranties.

About these Terms

We may modify these terms or any additional terms that apply to a Service to, for example, reflect changes to the law or changes to our Services. You should look at the terms regularly. We’ll post notice of modifications to these terms on this page. We’ll post notice of modified additional terms in the applicable Service. docPages.title: On-device AI model disclosure
docPages.html:
DisFly uses on-device generative AI models to summarize posts and generate replies in AI chat. Each platform uses its own system model. Check the model status in Settings → Intelligence.

Models and availability

Platform Model and requirements
iPhone, iPad, and Mac DisFly uses the local Apple Intelligence model through Apple’s Foundation Models framework. It requires iOS 26, iPadOS 26, or macOS 26 or later, a compatible device with Apple Intelligence enabled, and a ready model.
Android DisFly uses Gemini Nano through Google’s ML Kit Prompt API. A compatible device with Android AICore support is required. If the model is not ready, follow the download prompt in the app.

If the model is unavailable, DisFly does not send summaries or conversations to a cloud model. Post translation works separately: Apple devices use the system Translation framework, and Android uses Google Translate’s on-device models.

What the model receives

For summaries, DisFly sends the text of the relevant post or reply to the local model. For AI chat, the model receives the question you submit and recent turns needed to continue the conversation. This processing stays on your device. DisFly does not upload that content to generate summaries or chat replies. Downloading system models and loading forum posts may still require an internet connection.

Completed AI conversations are stored in encrypted history on your device. Go to Settings → Intelligence → AI chat history to view, continue, or delete individual conversations. You can still view or delete saved conversations after turning AI off.

Using AI output

Generated summaries and replies can omit details, misread a post, or invent information. Check the original post for details and review generated text before relying on it or sharing it.

Official references: Apple Foundation Models · Apple Intelligence requirements · Google ML Kit Prompt API

docPages.title: 本机 AI 模型使用声明
docPages.html:
谈坛使用设备上的生成式 AI 模型生成帖子摘要和 AI 对话回复。不同平台调用各自的系统模型，能否使用以应用中「设置 → 智能化」显示的状态为准。

使用哪些模型

平台 模型与使用条件
iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 通过 Apple Foundation Models 框架调用 Apple Intelligence 的本机模型。需要 iOS 26、iPadOS 26 或 macOS 26 及以上版本，并且设备支持、已启用 Apple Intelligence，模型已就绪。
Android 通过 Google ML Kit Prompt API 调用 Gemini Nano。需要兼容的设备和 Android AICore 支持；如果模型尚未就绪，可以按应用提示下载。

模型不可用时，谈坛不会把摘要或对话转发给云端模型。正文翻译有独立的实现和设置：Apple 设备使用系统 Translation 框架，Android 使用 Google 翻译的设备端模型。

哪些内容会交给模型

生成摘要时，谈坛把相关帖子或回复的正文交给本机模型。AI 对话使用你提交的问题，以及继续对话所需的近期问答。模型在设备上处理这些内容，谈坛不会为了生成摘要或回复把它们上传到云端。下载系统模型或读取论坛原帖仍可能需要联网。

已完成的 AI 对话保存在应用的本机加密历史中。你可以在「设置 → 智能化 → AI 对话历史」查看、继续或删除单条对话。关闭智能化后，仍可查看或删除已有历史。

如何使用生成结果

摘要和回复由模型生成，可能遗漏、误读或编造信息。需要确认细节时请阅读帖子原文，使用或分享生成内容前也请自行核对。

官方资料：Apple Foundation Models · Apple Intelligence 使用要求 · Google ML Kit Prompt API

docPages.title: Android post translation
docPages.html:
Android post translation in DisFly is powered by Google Translate using Google ML Kit on-device language identification and translation models. Translation works independently of the AI setting, including on devices that do not support Gemini Nano.

How to translate a post

  • Tap the translation icon in the post toolbar to translate into your device language. Tap it again to show the original.
  • Press and hold the translation icon to choose a target language. You can turn off automatic translation in the General section of Settings.
  • DisFly may need to download language packs over Wi‑Fi on first use. Once the packs are ready, you can translate already-loaded posts offline.

How DisFly handles your text

Translation runs on your device. DisFly does not send post text to a cloud translation service for this feature. Images and link destinations are preserved. If the download or translation fails, the original remains available, and DisFly does not fall back to generative AI.

Attribution and accuracy

Translations on Android are generated automatically by Google Translate. The Google Translate badge appears beside the translated content. Machine translation can get names, forum jargon, and context wrong. Check the original when the details matter.

Google provides no express or implied warranty for these translations, including as to accuracy, reliability, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or noninfringement. See Google’s full translation disclaimer.

See also: Google Cloud Translation · ML Kit on-device translation · On-device AI model disclosure

docPages.title: Android 正文翻译
docPages.html:
谈坛的 Android 正文翻译由 Google 翻译提供，使用 Google ML Kit 的设备端语言识别和翻译模型。翻译独立于「智能化」设置，关闭 AI 或设备不支持 Gemini Nano 时，仍可使用正文翻译。

如何翻译帖子

  • 点按帖子工具栏的翻译图标，默认翻译为设备语言。再次点按即可切回原文。
  • 长按翻译图标可以选择目标语言。「设置」的常规分组中可关闭自动翻译。
  • 首次翻译某些语言时，谈坛会通过 Wi‑Fi 按需下载语言包。下载完成后，已经加载的正文可以离线翻译。

数据如何处理

待翻译的正文文字在设备上处理。谈坛不会为了此功能把正文发送给云端翻译服务。翻译保留图片和链接地址；如果语言包未能下载或翻译失败，仍可阅读原文，应用不会自动改用生成式 AI 翻译。

翻译归属与准确性

Android 译文由 Google 翻译自动生成，译文旁会显示 Google 翻译标识。机器翻译可能出现错误，尤其是专有名词、论坛用语和需要结合上下文理解的段落。涉及重要信息时，请对照原文。

Google 不对译文作出任何明示或默示保证，包括准确性、可靠性、适销性、特定用途适用性或不侵权。完整声明请见 Google 翻译归属与免责声明。

相关资料：Google Cloud Translation 服务信息 · ML Kit 设备端翻译 · 本机 AI 模型使用声明
